long_biography.plain_text:
Frederik van der Plas joined Atlantex alongside his brother Dirk and Diek Parlevliet after their Dutch group bought half of the business. The investment brought Parlevliet & Van der Plas into joint ownership with Iceland’s Samherji. Atlantex’s operations extended beyond Europe to West African waters and the South Pacific.

The van der Plas family transferred its entire interest in Parlevliet & Van der Plas to the Parlevliet family in 2025. The company continued under its established name. Diek’s son Dirk-Jan Parlevliet became the group’s chief executive at the beginning of that year, succeeding his father.
